SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(e.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM scanenvironment WHERE imgcount IS NOT NULL) AS imgcount_diff_from_overall
FROM sites AS s
JOIN scanenvironment AS e ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.entrystat;
